Keep all labels legible with generous space. No actual customer identity, no real name/date, no success guarantees or claims this is currently implemented. Do not add controls that suggest face recognition, automatic masking or automatic background removal. This is screen 1 in the series, not a collage.

Use the supplied image as the VISUAL DESIGN AND FICTIONAL DEMO-PERSON REFERENCE for a NEW sibling screenshot, screen 2 of the PrintFlow Studio memorial-design flow. Keep the same brand header, white/mint/teal accessible desktop styling, large Chinese text, flat front-on 16:10 composition, six-step left navigation and the same fictional older man with navy jacket and gold lapel medal in a small reference thumbnail. This is a future UX concept, not implemented software. Keep the visible '交互设计稿 · 概念示意' badge.

Next area title '日期怎么解释？'. A visible dropdown value '日 / 月 / 年'. Two concise large explanation rows EXACT '出生：1939年6月12日' and '离世：2026年10月8日'. A small text label selector showing 'Sunrise / Sunset' as the chosen literal date labels. Do not reinterpret the dates as month/day/year.

The fictional name and dates are only demo UI data. Keep the table, date explanations and confirmation controls readable and uncrowded. This should look like a practical shippable app design review screenshot rather than a diagram or poster.
